γεννάω.shortDefinition: to birth, father; fig. to regenerate, make new

γεύομαι.shortDefinition: to taste; fig. to eat, experience

γῆ.shortDefinition: the earth, soil, dirt; fig. a land, territory

γίνομαι.shortDefinition: to come into being, become, make; fig. to happen, be born

γινώσκω.shortDefinition: to know intimately, to get acquainted with; fig. to have sexual intercourse with

γράφω.shortDefinition: to write, engrave, draw; fig. to describe
